body.name: Fixed-parameter algebraicity-tag algorithm
body.construction: In \(\mathsf{ArithmeticModel}\), construct the acyclic covariance parametrization in the source coordinates, form its Jacobian and the Jacobian augmented by the row of \(\lambda_e\), and compute their generic ranks by independently randomized exact source specializations. Return \((\operatorname{algebraic},\mathcal J_{G,e},2^{|D|-n+2})\) when the ranks agree and return \((\infty,\mathcal N_{G,e})\) when the augmented rank is larger. The transcript \(\mathcal J_{G,e}\) records the specialization, pivot minors, and source identity tests; \(\mathcal N_{G,e}\) additionally records the augmented minor witnessing dominance. This construction does not compute \(d_e(G)\), \(p_e\), \(\mathcal Q_{G,e}\), or \(h_{G,e}\) on the algebraic branch.
